docs.name: calc/bill
docs.text:
---
title: Dinner for six
---
food = 164.50
drinks = 58
tip = (food + drinks) * 18%
total = food + drinks + tip
total / 6

docs.name: calc/paint
docs.text:
---
title: Painting the front room
---
walls = 2 * (4.2 + 3.6) * 2.4
doors = 0.9 * 2.1
windows = 1.4 * 1.2 * 2
area = walls - doors - windows
litres = area * 2 / 12
ceil(litres / 2.5)
